newsitem.title: UK: Deltron Electronics float priced at 150 pence/shr.
newsitem.headline: Deltron Electronics float priced at 150 pence/shr.

text.p: Deltron Electronics Plc said on Thursday it would float on the London stock exchange at 150 pence per share, valuing the company at 27.6 million stg.
The placement, which will be of 9.054 million ordinary shares, aims to raise 6.45 million stg for the company.
Deltron is a specialist supplier of electronic components with operations in the UK and France.
Turnover was over 19.8 million stg in the nine months ending June 30 with operating profit expected to be not less than 2.75 million stg in the year ending September 30.
Pretax profit for the current financial year should be not less than 2.24 million stg, barring unforeseen circumstances, the company said.
"Flotation...will also enable us to continue the growth of Deltron, both organically and via strategic acquisition," chief executive Christopher Sawyer said in a statement.
